messages.content: The lender confirmed the handoff will be finished by 1:00 p.m. Thursday, and the equipment crate is shipping separately. I will only have my carry-on. Can we finish the Chicago flights now?

Yes. The Sunday outbound on the courtesy hold is still available: October 19, nonstop from Atlanta to Chicago O'Hare, departing at 6:20 p.m. and arriving at 7:32 p.m. The held Thursday return departs O'Hare at 7:05 p.m. There is also a 4:25 p.m. nonstop return now that the handoff time is confirmed.
Remind me of the arrival times in Atlanta and what the airport timing looks like for each Thursday flight.

The 4:25 p.m. flight arrives in Atlanta at 7:28 p.m. The 7:05 p.m. flight arrives at 10:08 p.m. If you leave the museum shortly after 1:00, the expected drive to O'Hare is about 45 to 65 minutes, giving you roughly two hours or more before the 4:25 departure. The later flight would add about two hours and forty minutes of waiting at the airport.
So the 4:25 does not require checking the crate or getting it to the airline first, correct? It is going directly with the shipper.

Correct. The crate is not part of your airline reservation and does not need to be taken to O'Hare. Your flight booking will show one traveler with carry-on baggage only. The shipping arrangement remains separate.
Then switch the return to 4:25. Is the round-trip price still $428, or did changing that leg affect it?

The 4:25 p.m. return adds $16. The revised round-trip total is $444 for one traveler, including taxes and fees. No checked bag is included; one standard carry-on and one personal item are included. The itinerary remains nonstop in both directions.
Before you book, give me the full itinerary once more and confirm the hold has not already produced a charge.

Outbound: Sunday, October 19, Atlanta to Chicago O'Hare, 6:20 p.m. to 7:32 p.m., nonstop. Return: Thursday, October 23, Chicago O'Hare to Atlanta, 4:25 p.m. to 7:28 p.m., nonstop. The total is $444 for Avery Thompson alone. The courtesy hold CHI-4K82 has not been ticketed, and no charge has been made so far.
That works. Use the payment method already attached to the hold and book the round trip at $444.
Please confirm that you authorize a charge of $444 to the payment method ending in 1842 for the October 19-23 round trip.
I authorize the $444 charge to the card ending in 1842.

The round trip is booked and ticketed for Avery Thompson under confirmation CHI-4K82. The card ending in 1842 was charged $444. You depart Atlanta at 6:20 p.m. Sunday, October 19, and return from O'Hare at 4:25 p.m. Thursday, October 23, arriving in Atlanta at 7:28 p.m. Both flights are nonstop, and the reservation includes a carry-on and personal item but no checked bag. The equipment crate is not attached to the airline booking.
